description: OMENZ Checkout (open): ONE call before your agent pays any x402 seller. Send the url (or just q = what you need and OMENZ picks the cheapest seller that answers right now), your max price, optional Shared Budget (budget_id + X-Budget-Key) and policy. Runs Authorize (live quote, payTo, fair price, policy), the seller's OMENZ track record, and draws from the team budget: GO / REVIEW / STOP + checkout_id + signed 5-minute authorization. Provider-neutral, any wallet; never touches your money. High volume: checkout/open/credit at 1% of the purchase (min $0.0002). By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/checkout/open, $0.002 via x402.)

expected_pay_to.description: payout wallet you expect (0x...), to catch swapped payees

max_price_usd.description: most you are willing to pay per call, in USD

method.description: HTTP method of the target endpoint (GET or POST)
